motif_target: floor(size/10) distinct anchor ASes, each retains two distinct inferred providers
motif_purpose: internal scenario coverage target, NOT measured Internet prevalence or a formal project KPI
seed_rule: uniform among top ceil(1 percent) eligible nodes by domain degree, ties by ASN
anchor_rule: seeded permutation of eligible ASes with at least two known providers; add each anchor, two seeded providers and a deterministic shortest adjacency path to root; reject bundles exceeding node budget; fail if target not reached
fill_rule: largest unmet absolute full-union stratum quota on connected frontier
control: same-size stratified uniform node sample without connectivity or motif constraints
boundary: all full-union cut edges recorded, no synthetic reconnecting edges
unknown: retain unknown/conflicting induced edges as inactive evidence; never infer peer
selection_bias: motif anchors and connection paths oversample providers/core; diagnose against both full union and eligible known domain
replication: same-source seed sensitivity, not independent Internet samples
